description: Ministry of Defence - Award the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal and Clasp to the Persons
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal & Clasp to naval personnel. This falls under public service administration as it deals with service recognition, awards, and personnel matters within the armed forces, which is part of the broader public sector service system. The content lists specific individuals receiving the award but focuses on service recognition rather than government appointments or structural changes, making it a Public Service Gazette (Type 8).
